en: Job 30

p.src: 1  “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

en: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
u.src: 1  “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

p.src: 2  Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

en: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
u.src: 2  Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

p.src: 3  They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

en: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
u.src: 3  They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

p.src: 4  They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

en: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
u.src: 4  They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

p.src: 5  They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

en: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
u.src: 5  They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

p.src: 6  so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

en: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
u.src: 6  so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

p.src: 7  They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

en: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
u.src: 7  They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

p.src: 8  They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

en: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
u.src: 8  They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

p.src: 9  “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
u.src: 9  “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

p.src: 10  They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

en: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
u.src: 10  They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

p.src: 11  For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

en: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
u.src: 11  For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

p.src: 12  On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

en: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
u.src: 12  On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

p.src: 13  They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

en: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
u.src: 13  They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

p.src: 14  As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

en: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
u.src: 14  As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

p.src: 15  Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

en: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
u.src: 15  Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

p.src: 16  “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

en: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
u.src: 16  “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

p.src: 17  In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

en: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
u.src: 17  In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

p.src: 18  My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

en: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
u.src: 18  My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

p.src: 19  He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

en: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
u.src: 19  He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

p.src: 20  I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

en: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
u.src: 20  I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

p.src: 21  You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

en: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
u.src: 21  You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

p.src: 22  You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

en: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
u.src: 22  You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

p.src: 23  For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

en: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
u.src: 23  For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

p.src: 24  “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

en: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
u.src: 24  “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

p.src: 25  Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

en: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
u.src: 25  Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

p.src: 26  When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

en: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
u.src: 26  When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

p.src: 27  My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

en: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
u.src: 27  My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

p.src: 28  I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

en: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
u.src: 28  I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

p.src: 29  I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

en: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
u.src: 29  I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

p.src: 30  My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

en: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
u.src: 30  My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

p.src: 31  Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

en: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
u.src: 31  Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
